page.notes: The Greek word after "Colophonis loco adjiciam" is only partly legible; the reading ἀποχρηματισμὸν is a best guess. "tra-ctandum" is also uncertain: the ligature after the hyphen is hard to read. The left margin strip belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out. The line "pomœria,hi fines" is printed without a space after the comma; it is written with a space here. No catchword or signature is visible.
